' REQ: LANG-2381 LANG-2382 LANG-2383 LANG-2384
@startuml
' Sequence diagram
title Greeting
actor User
participant "Web App" as App
database DB
User -> App : open page
activate App
App -> DB : SELECT greeting
DB --> App : "Hello"
alt found
  App -> User : show greeting
else not found
  App -> User : error
end
@enduml
